severity.description: Severity is a consumer-defined alert classification.

AlertConditionSpec.description: AlertConditionSpec defines an alert's severity and breach condition.

op.description: Operator compares the calculated burn rate with Threshold.

threshold.description: Threshold sets the numeric burn-rate boundary.

lookbackWindow.description: LookbackWindow sets the period for burn-rate calculation.

alertAfter.description: AlertAfter sets how long the burn-rate comparison must remain true before the condition becomes breaching.

AlertConditionType.description: AlertConditionType defines a burn-rate comparison over a lookback window.

Annotations.description: Annotations maps annotation keys to arbitrary string values.

DurationShorthand.description: A shorthand representation of time duration, e.g. '1m', '10d', '2w'.

Labels.description: Labels maps label keys to one string value each.

name.description: Name identifies the object when other OpenSLO objects refer to it.

labels.description: Labels classifies the object with Kubernetes-style, single-valued labels.

annotations.description: Annotations attaches non-identifying metadata to the object.

Metadata.description: Metadata is the Kubernetes-style identifying metadata used by v2alpha objects.

description: AlertCondition defines when an SLO alert condition is breaching.
